system.description:
Haywire. Make a CR 1 Strange Check to deactivate a mechanical device or make it malfunction. Also +1 Talent Die when handling otherworldly technology.

The Cat Knows (Flaw). Animals avoid you where they can and attack if you get too close. In a Combat Encounter, animals always target you first.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.92
